target.name: Robinhood Chain mainnet
target.limit_interpretation: Planning conversion treats KB as KiB; verify exact chain configuration and deployment simulation before broadcasting.

counting_policy: Each slot is one intended deployed contract instance. Reusable storage-page code can instantiate many addresses. Internal Solidity libraries are not additional deployed contracts. Repeats/lambda windows are state records, not deployment counts. Planned semantic partitions are not evidence that the dataset requires 64 contracts.

dependency_policy.deployment_dependencies: Must exist before this instance is deployed or linked. This graph must be acyclic.
dependency_policy.configuration_dependencies: Bound and validated before experiment freeze; may point to instances deployed later. The coordinator is deployed before writer-restricted pages and is configured with them once.

experimental_source_candidates.scope: Compiled experimental registry for protocol/module identity and hashes; complete production protocol and scientific-input freeze semantics still require implementation and validation.

Experimental trusted-page factory and immutable ordered registry for initial position/bond streams. DynamicsDataset extends these streams with additional finite-system inputs; complete production scientific schemas remain unfinished.

Experimental trusted-page factory and frozen extension of a base coordinate/bond dataset with masses, initial velocities, harmonic angles, periodic torsions and explicitly listed direct pairs. Commits canonical schemas and exact coverage; physical domains are checked by the consuming coordinator.

Bounded append-only pages with irreversible sealing, used for current development schemas covering coordinates, masses/velocities, bonds, angles, proper torsions and explicit direct pairs. Reusable page instances are not completed implementations of all production input roles.

Compiled legacy harmonic-bond checkpoint fixture storing operands internally; alternative experimental path to PagedBondCoordinator, not an additional completed production slot or a dynamics/free-energy engine.

Compiled paged harmonic-bond fixture with resumable atom/bond validation, force accumulation and output sealing. Reads DatasetCatalog pages, writes WorkingStatePage namespaces, and permits at most 4096 atoms/16384 bonds. Isolated Lennard-Jones and Coulomb pair kernels are not wired into this coordinator; no dynamics integration.

Experimental finite-system velocity-Verlet coordinator using frozen paged data, all implemented bonded and listed direct-pair kernels, deterministic staged execution and double-buffered state. Supports resumable timesteps and completion barriers; no periodic box, PME, thermostat, constraints, replica/alchemical sampling or full protein claim. This and the two harmonic coordinators are alternative experimental implementations, not three completed production slots.

Generic immutable-writer namespaces used for force/energy fixtures and the dynamics coordinator double-buffered positions, velocities, forces and potential energy. The dynamics writer imposes timestep barriers; this does not complete the remaining production working-state roles.

Standalone binary128-format arithmetic wrapper containing the pinned internal ABDK library. The internal library is not an additional deployment; extreme-domain and propagated-error budgets for production remain unresolved.

Bounded deterministic binary128-format atan2, acos and sine/cosine functions for angular kernels, using documented polynomial/range-reduction semantics. Does not provide a complete correctly-rounded elementary-function suite, production exp/log or a propagated MD error budget.
Harmonic-bond energy/force kernel connected to both legacy harmonic fixtures and DynamicsCoordinator; primitive validation does not establish a full solvated-protein force field.

Standard harmonic-angle energy and three-atom analytic forces, connected to DynamicsCoordinator with declared finite/noncollinear geometry domains and registered parameters; not a full protein force-field validation.

Periodic proper-torsion energy and four-atom analytic forces using the declared signed dihedral convention, connected to DynamicsCoordinator. Does not implement every production improper/CMAP or force-field torsion form.

Unswitched direct Lennard-Jones pair kernel using explicitly supplied sigma/epsilon, connected through DynamicsCoordinator listed-pair records. No automatic mixing, pair enumeration, exclusions, cutoff, periodic images or tail correction; the older PagedBondCoordinator remains harmonic only.

Direct Coulomb pair kernel using explicitly supplied charge product/prefactor, connected through DynamicsCoordinator listed pairs. This is not Ewald/PME real-space electrostatics and supplies no periodic images, reaction field or automatic dielectric convention; PagedBondCoordinator remains harmonic only.

Deterministic velocity-Verlet drift and final kick primitives used by DynamicsCoordinator. This is an integration foundation related to the planned Langevin slot, not an implemented Langevin thermostat or a production ensemble claim.
Bounded minimum-image geometry for a constant orthorhombic box with declared half-box tie behavior and image-ratio bound. Not triclinic or variable-cell geometry.

Quintic-switched Lennard-Jones plus conducting-limit reaction-field Coulomb, or direct uncut explicit exceptions. This development electrostatics model is not Ewald/PME or a selected production myosin Hamiltonian.

Sealed per-particle nonbonded parameters, explicit pair exceptions and constant box/cutoff configuration extending a frozen DynamicsDataset without listed pairs. Scientific topology completeness still requires prepared-input validation.

Alternative staged velocity-Verlet coordinator with bonded minimum images, exhaustive lexicographic unordered-pair enumeration, on-chain Lorentz-Berthelot mixing and explicit exclusion/override handling. Double-buffered commit barriers and deterministic transaction partitioning; no neighbor list, PME, thermostat or production model claim.
Finite bounded log/exp/erf/erfc and cancellation-aware log1p/expm1; independent high-precision fixtures, no complete propagated molecular error budget.
Counter-addressed exact-grid open-interval uniforms and Box-Muller normals; registered seed/stream/replica/step/draw identity, no block entropy.
Immutable-writer resumable displacement check, reference copy and candidate list construction; conservative skin reuse, lexicographic pairs, quadratic rebuild cost.

Alternative NVE coordinator with cached neighbor-list traversal matching the exhaustive periodic baseline; explicit original-external or exact-runtime-pinned inline pair admission with unchanged protocol/state commitments. Full-system scale remains unresolved.
Binary128-format BAOAB drift/thermostat/kick primitives with registered deterministic normal inputs; finite declared domains.
Neighbor-list BAOAB development dynamics with counter-based stochastic streams; separate from constrained and Ewald coordinators, not a combined production sampler.
Mass-weighted SHAKE position and RATTLE velocity pair corrections with fail-closed geometric domains.
Resumable iterative position/velocity constraints with separate full residual assessment, fixed tolerances and explicit convergence failure.
Sealed canonical distance-constraint sets bound to registered dataset identity; not automatic force-field constraint derivation.
Alternative neighbor-list NVE dynamics with SHAKE before forces and RATTLE before atomic state commit; not a constrained Langevin/Ewald/alchemical engine.
Resumable complete periodic forces, gradient RMS and monotone Armijo backtracking; explicit convergence/iteration failure and no off-chain minimization result submission.
Truncated erfc-screened pair electrostatics primitive with finite domains; production alpha/cutoff error calibration remains required.
Explicit canonical half-space reciprocal modes, charge structure factors, mode energy and force; direct Ewald sums, not PME mesh/FFT.
Self, uniform neutralizing background and excluded/scaled intracell pair corrections for declared tin-foil Ewald convention.
Bounded full direct Ewald forces on immutable factory-issued frozen snapshots; separate work state and terminal sealing.
Alternative periodic NVE dynamics adding frozen-snapshot Ewald passes to LJ/bonded forces without reaction-field double counting; separate from constraints/Langevin.
Two-endpoint p=2 softcore LJ energy, force and lambda derivative; primitive only, no complete charge/bonded hybrid Hamiltonian or production sampler.
Replica-exchange and symmetric-volume-proposal acceptance math; actual proposals, rollback, volume rescaling and exchange scheduling are not integrated.

Optional inlined binary128 switched-LJ/reaction-field kernel, sampled bitwise-equivalent to the original external path; explicitly admitted by NeighborDynamicsCoordinator under runtime/provenance checks. Other coordinators retain external kernels; no full-system feasibility claim.
Writer-bound chronological frozen-policy energy collection and on-chain reduced-potential centering; no approved production simulation writer yet.
Resumable 2-16 state log-sum-exp MBAR fixed point with gauge fixing, refreshed denominators and explicit nonconvergence; synthetic reference validation.
MBAR normalization, weight ESS and overlap connectivity under preregistered thresholds; weight ESS is not temporal decorrelation or proof of equilibration.
Writer-bound chronological observable covariance, Geyer positive/monotone pairs and conservative statistical inefficiency with explicit constant/short/truncated flags.
Preregistered complete paired independent-repeat plans and on-chain mean/SEM of complex-minus-solvent estimates; no MBAR covariance or proven repeat independence.

experimental_build.scope: Separate experimental source/build evidence; the compiled_sizes report and validation_summary establish completed checks. Does not change any production-slot implementation status or indicate a Robinhood deployment.
experimental_build.gas_scope: Measured local fixtures and explicitly hypothetical workload projections. No complete prepared-model estimate, current mainnet fee or demonstrated throughput.
experimental_build.count_semantics: Distinct experimental deployable contract types, not addresses or completed production slots. Alternative coordinators do not compose automatically; reusable page types can have many instances.

paged_execution.working_state: isolated force and energy accumulators only; no current/next dynamics state
paged_execution.singular_geometry_check: Running stage; revert rolls back the current transaction, while successful earlier checkpoints remain partial work
paged_execution.scope: Retained v0.2 harmonic-only regression implementation; DynamicsCoordinator is the separate v0.3 path.

dynamics_execution.system_scope: finite explicitly declared interaction system, no periodic boundary
dynamics_execution.working_state: Two buffers of position, velocity and force vectors plus per-buffer potential energies in a writer-restricted namespace; timestep buffer changes only after the final kick stage completes.
dynamics_execution.partial_state: Loading and initial force stages are not a committed timestep. Failed transactions roll back their coordinator and page writes; earlier checkpoints persist. Final completion seals the namespace.
dynamics_execution.capacity_scope: Development guards, not the intended solvated-myosin system capacity or scientifically sufficient sampling duration.

periodic_execution.dataset: PeriodicDataset extending frozen DynamicsDataset and DatasetCatalog inputs
periodic_execution.integrator: deterministic velocity-Verlet with unwrapped stored coordinates
periodic_execution.ordinary_pair_enumeration: Every unordered pair i<j, lexicographic order; quadratic full scan each force pass; no neighbor list
periodic_execution.ordinary_parameters: Lorentz-Berthelot sigma/epsilon and product of registered atomic charges, calculated on-chain
periodic_execution.ordinary_potential: quintic-switched LJ plus conducting-limit reaction-field Coulomb; both zero at/beyond cutoff
periodic_execution.exceptions: canonical sorted explicit exclusions or direct uncut LJ/Coulomb parameter overrides; periodic minimum images
periodic_execution.geometry: minimum-image bonded arms and chain vectors; strict ordinary cutoff below every half-box length

scientific_blockers: A complete prepared solvated hybrid cardiac-myosin/ligand model, repaired coordinates, microstates, compatible force-field terms, ions and parameters are not frozen.
Mg-ADP-vanadate is the original structural state. Public ADP-plus-phosphate models provide a declared alternative research route, not validated drop-in parameters for this target.
The heavy-atom transformation is mapped, but hybrid endpoint parameters, inserted/deleted atom coordinates and validated compound-17 pose remain unresolved. Functional ATPase IC50 is not Kd.
Neighbor, Ewald, constrained NVE and Langevin paths are separate validated development candidates; no single complete production Hamiltonian/ensemble/alchemical pipeline exists.
Analysis components use synthetic harnesses. Real on-chain sampling, correlation-aware input selection, complete repeat provenance and sufficient convergence evidence remain unfinished.

The actual prepared-system atom/page counts, target-chain cost and sufficient sampling budget are unknown. Current caps and quadratic rebuild/direct-reciprocal work are not validated for the intended solvated protein.
A combined full-system security/scientific validation, live Robinhood fork rehearsal and final operator transaction plan are missing.

slots.name: ExperimentRegistry
slots.purpose: Records immutable scientific protocol versions, allowed module code hashes, seeds, input roots and experiment lifecycle permissions.
slots.notes: Registry administration and immutable experiment registration.

slots.name: DatasetCatalog
slots.purpose: Registers sealed input-page addresses, their schemas, content digests, licenses, provenance and complete byte coverage.
slots.notes: Manifest and data-availability validation; never substitutes a content hash for accessible input bytes.

slots.name: SimulationCoordinator
slots.purpose: Owns the execution cursor, enforces stage barriers and allowed writes, and commits bounded numerical work atomically.
slots.notes: Permissionless bounded advanceExperiment; shared current-state snapshot and complete-step commit.

slots.name: WorkScheduler
slots.purpose: Selects the next deterministic experiment, replica, lambda state and computation tile from registered schedules.
slots.notes: Caller identity, wall-clock time and transaction batch size cannot change scientific work order.

slots.name: FloatingPointArithmetic
slots.purpose: Specified floating-point add, subtract, multiply, divide, comparisons and conversion, with explicit finite-value and rounding policy.

slots.name: ElementaryFunctions
slots.purpose: Specified square root, exponential, logarithm and other required elementary functions, with measured error bounds.

slots.name: VectorGeometry
slots.purpose: Distances, dot/cross products, periodic-cell geometry and stable bond/angle/torsion geometric primitives.

slots.name: CounterRandom
slots.purpose: Registered-seed counter generator and documented normal/uniform transforms; independent streams per replica and operation.

slots.name: HarmonicBondForces

slots.name: HarmonicAngleForces
